title: Escherichia coli FtsZ molecular dynamics simulations.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟含C端无序区域(IDR)的FtsZ蛋白单体，揭示GTP结合诱导的构象变化及IDR对聚合机制的影响，虽非直接PPI但聚焦IDR构象机制建模，方法为物理模拟，对本课题有启发。
abstract: Earlier molecular dynamics studies of the FtsZ protein revealed that the protein has high intrinsic flexibility which the crystal structures cannot reveal. However, the input structure in these simulation studies was based on the available crystal structure data and therefore, the effect of the C-terminal Intrinsically Disordered Region (IDR) of FtsZ could not be observed in any of these studies. Recent investigations have revealed that the C-terminal IDR is crucial for FtsZ assembly in vitro and Z ring formation in vivo. Therefore, in this study, we simulated FtsZ with the IDR. Simulations of the FtsZ monomer in different nucleotide bound forms (without nucleotide, GTP, GDP) were performed. In the conformations of FtsZ monomer with GTP, GTP binds variably with the protein. Such a variable interaction with the monomer has not been observed in any previous simulation studies of FtsZ and not observed in crystal structures. We found that central helix bends towards the C-terminal domain in the GTP bound form, hence, making way for polymerization. A nucleotide dependent shift/rotation of the C-terminal domain was observed in simulation time averaged structures.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 早期的FtsZ蛋白分子动力学（molecular dynamics）研究揭示，该蛋白具有晶体结构无法展现的高内在灵活性。然而，这些模拟研究中的输入结构基于现有的晶体结构数据，因此，FtsZ的C端内在无序区（Intrinsically Disordered Region, IDR）的影响在这些研究中均未被观察到。近期研究表明，C端IDR对FtsZ体外组装和体内Z环形成至关重要。因此，在本研究中，我们模拟了包含IDR的FtsZ。对FtsZ单体在不同核苷酸结合形式（无核苷酸、GTP、GDP）下进行了模拟。在GTP结合的FtsZ单体构象中，GTP与蛋白的相互作用具有变异性。这种与单体的可变相互作用在以往任何FtsZ模拟研究中均未被观察到，也未在晶体结构中发现。我们发现，在GTP结合形式下，中央螺旋向C端结构域弯曲，从而为聚合开辟了通路。在模拟时间平均结构中，观察到C端结构域发生核苷酸依赖性的位移/旋转。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
